body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its high performance 14.1-inch notebook pc ‘S60’ during KES 20007, which supports Intel’s Santa Rosa platform. The S60 features 2.5-inch SATA HDD, 1.3M camera, fingerprint recognition and Bluetooth function.
